rfpBrief.objective: Build awareness and drive quote requests for residential solar plus home battery systems
rfpBrief.audience: Homeowners aged 35-65; priority on solar-ready and high utility spend households
rfpBrief.agency_channel_guidance: CTV at least 40% of budget; audio optional but preferred in TX and FL commute markets

kpis.unique_household_reach_target: 35% of homeowners 35-65 in the five states
kpis.frequency_cap: 3 per household per week on CTV and OLV combined

guardrails: Brand safety tier_1 only for video
No adjacency to fossil-fuel advertisers within the same ad pod
Competitive separation from other solar installers
Sustainability and home content adjacency preferred
deliverables: Recommended products with rate card and negotiated CPMs
Budget split by channel and by state
Available impressions by month for Jan-Mar 2025
Projected unique reach, frequency and completed views
Measurement plan: brand lift study and quote-request attribution

advertiserProfile.brand_positioning: Lower home energy bills with reliable clean power

prior_campaigns.results: Brand lift +3.8 pts awareness; cost per quote request 112 USD
Brand lift +4.6 pts awareness; cost per quote request 94 USD; audio drove 18% of quote requests
